entries.title: Psalms 144:1
segments: ¶<<[A Psalm] of David.>> Blessed [be] the LORD my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, [and] my fingers to fight: {strength: Heb. rock} {to war...: Heb. to the war, etc}

words.text: : {strength: Heb. rock} {to war...: Heb. to the war, etc}

entries.title: Psalms 144:2
segments: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and [he] in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me. {My goodness: or, My mercy}

words.text: under me. {My goodness: or, My mercy}

entries.title: Psalms 144:3
segments: LORD, what [is] man, that thou takest knowledge of him! [or] the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

entries.title: Psalms 144:4
segments: Man is like to vanity: his days [are] as a shadow that passeth away.

entries.title: Psalms 144:5
segments: Bow thy heavens, O LORD, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

entries.title: Psalms 144:6
segments: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

entries.title: Psalms 144:7
segments: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children; {hand from: Heb. hands from}

entries.title: Psalms 144:8
segments: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand [is] a right hand of falsehood.

entries.title: Psalms 144:9
segments: ¶I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery [and] an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

entries.title: Psalms 144:10
segments: [It is he] that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword. {salvation: or, victory}

entries.title: Psalms 144:11
segments: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand [is] a right hand of falsehood:

entries.title: Psalms 144:12
segments: That our sons [may be] as plants grown up in their youth; [that] our daughters [may be] as corner stones, polished [after] the similitude of a palace: {polished: Heb. cut}

entries.title: Psalms 144:13
segments: [That] our garners [may be] full, affording all manner of store: [that] our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets: {all...: Heb. from kind to kind}

entries.title: Psalms 144:14
segments: [That] our oxen [may be] strong to labour; [that there be] no breaking in, nor going out; that [there be] no complaining in our streets. {strong...: Heb. able to bear burdens, or, loaden with flesh}

words.text: . {strong...: Heb. able to bear burdens, or, loaden with flesh}

entries.title: Psalms 144:15
segments: Happy [is that] people, that is in such a case: [yea], happy [is that] people, whose God [is] the LORD.

words.text: , that is in such a case
